children: Comstock announced a $1.65 billion letter of intent with SOCAR to sell non‑operated Haynesville and Pinnacle interests and a $450 million drilling JV with Jerry Jones.
SOCAR LOI: SOCAR to acquire 20% of Legacy Haynesville, 15% (falling to 7.5%) of Western Haynesville, and 15% of Comstock’s 73% Pinnacle stake for $1.65B cash.
Effective date: Transaction will have an effective date of July 1, 2026; parties bound to negotiate a definitive purchase and sale agreement.
Pro forma deleveraging: Comstock expects net debt to fall from $3.1B to $1.5B as of June 30, 2026 using proceeds from the transaction.
$450M drilling venture: Jones family partnership will fund ~85% of 18 Western and 80% of nine Legacy wells (~$450M); 50% interest reverts to Comstock after a 15% ROI.
Comstock retains operatorship and control of upstream and Pinnacle midstream; SOCAR gets pro rata rights for future participation and marketing benefits.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
